story.fullStory:
Janet Jackson's "If" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "If" is a song by American singer-songwriter Janet Jackson from her fifth album, Janet (1993).

Jackson co-wrote and co-produced "If" with Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis, with Harvey Fuqua, John Bristol and Jackey Beavers receiving songwriting credits for the sampling of their composition "Someday We'll Be Together", performed by Diana Ross & the Supremes.

"If" was released as the album's second single on July 13, 1993, by Virgin Records.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 27 weeks on the chart.
